Five TDD grill findings resolved. Artifact SHA256s match packet. Three low-sev green-lean tests mitigated by paired RED assertions. Accept tdd_review.

- source: `cursor_self_reported`
- rationale: Static trace confirms RED genuineness (12 test names absent, net-new symbols grep0 in driver, direct-write _write_json, no-bytes _run_prune, no classifier). Planning artifact SHA256s verified against packet. Confidence capped below 0.9 because no live pytest RED-run or executed_test receipts exist at this planning gate.

- _write_json:560-562 is direct write; _run_prune:392-405 has no reclaimed bytes

- Planning artifact SHA256s match supervisor packet (verified locally)

### Strongest Objection

- reviewer_id: `independent-reviewer-1`
- decision: `revise`
- severity: `high`
- confidence: `0.87`
- text: The implementation violates the promise that resume skips only completed dry-oracle instances. In scripts/swebench_pro_batch_driver.py, curate_roster loads valid checkpoints at lines 606-630 before considering run_dry_oracle, and writes checkpoints at lines 704-728 even when run_dry_oracle is false with dry_oracle status not_run. Because main defaults resume_from_checkpoints on, a prior no-live/planning run in the same output_dir can create valid checkpoints that a later Phase 0 dry-oracle run will trust and skip, promoting non-oracle evidence.

### Message

Independent Cursor review confirms Phase 0 curation hardening is ready to advance. Supervisor runtime floor attempt 3 passed all receipts; I independently verified driver/test sha256 against packet pins, confirmed all 12 non-vacuous tests exist, and reran all 12 nodeids in the source repo (12/12 passed). Amendment hashes match on-disk bytes; prior deliverable-shape failure is corrected. Residual gap: git-diff receipt omits implementation files from its enumerated list.

### Confidence

- value: `0.89`
- source: `cursor_self_reported`
- rationale: All 12 acceptance tests pass in source repo; driver/test sha256 match packet and amendment pins; amendment self-consistency verified; runtime floor attempt 3 all green. Held below 0.9 due to git-diff receipt enumeration gap and incomplete reviewer worktree snapshot requiring cross-repo verification.

### Criteria

- All 12 TDD tests present and non-vacuous: met
- Driver/test sha256 match packet pins: met (independently computed)
- Amendment new_sha256 match current bytes: met (verified in source repo)
- All 12 pytest nodeids pass: met (12/12 in source repo)
- Runtime floor attempt 3 receipts all passed: met
- Git-diff receipt fully enumerates implementation files: not met (14 omitted, mitigated by deliverables check)

### Strongest Objection

- reviewer_id: `independent-reviewer-1`
- decision: `revise`
- severity: `high`
- confidence: `0.9`
- text: The implementation violates the core resume promise. In scripts/swebench_pro_batch_driver.py, curate_roster loads and resumes valid checkpoints before considering run_dry_oracle, while the same function writes curated checkpoints with dry_oracle status not_run when run_dry_oracle is false. Because CLI resume defaults on, a prior no-dry-oracle run in the same output_dir can cause a later Phase 0 dry-oracle run to skip oracle execution and promote non-oracle evidence.

### Cursor Outcome

Independent Cursor review confirms Phase 0 curation hardening is ready to advance. Supervisor runtime floor attempt 3 passed all receipts; I independently verified driver/test sha256 against packet pins, confirmed all 12 non-vacuous tests exist, and reran all 12 nodeids in the source repo (12/12 passed). Amendment hashes match on-disk bytes; prior deliverable-shape failure is corrected. Residual gap: git-diff receipt omits implementation files from its enumerated list.

Claims:

- Implementation diff is genuine with real atomic-write, checkpoint, resume, disk-floor, and prune seams-not stubs
- All 12 TDD-named acceptance tests exist, are non-vacuous, and pass in the source repo
- Amendment file is real (7367 bytes), append-only, and hash-consistent with driver, test, and unchanged prereg
- Prior runtime failure (directory deliverable, missing diff reconciliation) is corrected in attempt 3
- Supervisor packet validation.status passed with zero failures

- accept

- Low-sev: runtime-git-diff-outcome_review-3 visible changed_files list excludes scripts/tests/amendment (14 omitted); audit trail relies on deliverables check + packet sha256 rather than a unified diff enumeration.
- Low-sev: reviewer worktree snapshot lacks prereg/amendment artifacts and git metadata; full verification required reading source repo paths outside the snapshot.

Specialists:

- `Cursor Reviewer`: `accept` — objection: Git-diff receipt still lists only workflow docs with 14 omitted files; implementation paths are validated via deliverables check and packet sha256 but not fully enumerated in the diff receipt itself.
